entries.title: Queue a change with a label
entries.body: Teammates who do not use Infinitary can now put a change in the batch queue on GitHub or GitLab by adding the infinitary-queue label. The queue takes it only from someone allowed to merge, at the version the label went on, and a later push needs the label again. On GitLab, the label is read the next time the queue starts. Your first mate offers the queue update to projects that use it.
entries.noPicture: This adds a label the queue reads on GitHub and GitLab, not a change to any screen.
